Loc.Name: Hollow Courtier
Loc.Description: A porcelain attendant of a court that no longer exists. Wind it, and it still bows to an empty throne.

Items.DesignNote: Doll-class summon consumable, wiring copied verbatim from live DOLL_HUMAN_01 (Interactable {DOLL_SUMMON_01: null}, ConsumableType COMBAT, Stacks true - the proven PLAYTHING pattern; DOLL_SUMMON_01 has RequiresSkillRoll:false so it sidesteps the PERFECT gate, but still needs a free tile per C-SMN-01). The summoned plaything acts the same round and vanishes at combat end (C-SMN-02/03). Deviates from the generic equippable template because live DOLL items are consumables with no Equippable/slots.

Loc.Name: Scepter of the Hollow Court
Loc.Description: The old regent's staff of office. Tap it thrice on cold stone and something pale remembers it was once summoned to serve.

Items.DesignNote: Summoner staff: STAFF ClassAbilityTemplate kept verbatim (MAGIC_BASIC_ATTACK, CURSED_FOLLOWER_CURSE_ATTACK on INT/3), plus SUMMON_GHOST_ATTACK - a real live ADD_CHARACTER ability (RANDOM/GHOST) with SkillRollData wiring copied from BOOK_MILITIA_DARK_02's MAGIC_SUMMON_UNDEAD_ATTACK (MinValue 0/MaxValue 0/Stat INT), tuned from Rolls 3 to Rolls 2: ADD_CHARACTER lands only on a PERFECT roll with a free tile (C-SMN-01), and fewer roll slots or focus auto-successes make that PERFECT reliable (C-STAT-08). FOC 1 feeds the same loop.

Loc.Name: Signet of the Vacant Throne
Loc.Description: Whoever wears the seal speaks with the crown's authority. The dead still answer to it out of habit.

Items.DesignNote: Focus battery for the summoner: pinned focus points force roll slots to auto-SUCCEED (C-STAT-08), which is exactly what ADD_CHARACTER summons need to hit their PERFECT gate (C-SMN-01). FOC 2 mirrors live TRINKET_BUFF_FOCUS_02 (observed max for ARMOR_TRINKET|RARE); SKILL_REFOCUS is a verified live focus-gain source (C-FOC-05).

Loc.Name: Crown of the Hollow Court
Loc.Description: Tarnished silver over a brow no one remembers. The court it commands is patient, quiet, and very cold.

Items.DesignNote: Set artifact and summoner capstone: SKILL_DISCIPLINE grants party focus on kill/crit (C-FOC-05), and focus is the summoner's currency - each pinned point auto-succeeds a roll slot (C-STAT-08), converting kills into the PERFECT rolls that ADD_CHARACTER summons require (C-SMN-01). INT 5 / FOC 1 / PRES 3 all within observed ARMOR_HEAD|ARTIFACT curve (maxes 6/1/5).

Loc.Name: Stormcaller's Rod
Loc.Description: Cut from a mast that survived nine strikes. The tenth lives in the grain, waiting to be spent.

Items.DesignNote: WAND ClassAbilityTemplate kept verbatim (confuse/pull/stun on INT), extended with two live abilities: WAND_LIGHTNING_ATTACK (CHANGE_STAT HP + ADD_STATUS STATUS_SHOCK_00, params from live WAND_MILITIA_LIGHTNING_02) and IMBUE_ORB_SHOCK_ATTACK (ADD_STATUS STATUS_IMBUE_SHOCK_00 on an ALLY, wiring from live ORB_LIGHTNING_LIGHT_00, Rolls 4). ADD_STATUS only lands on PERFECT (C-STATUS-10); SHOCK then auto-fails one enemy roll slot unless focused (C-STATUS-20); the imbue makes an ally apply shock on every damaging hit (C-STATUS-19). Passives mirror the live lightning wand (STATUS_IMMUNITY_SHOCK + SKILL_SUPPORTRANGE).

Loc.Name: Thunderhead Repeater
Loc.Description: Each bolt hums like a storm rolling in over the plains. Struck targets forget which hand holds their sword.

Items.DesignNote: The HANDBOW ClassAbilityTemplate IS the live lightning handbow kit (BOW_LIGHTNING_ATTACK / BOW_LIGHTNING_PUSH_ATTACK, both CHANGE_STAT HP + ADD_STATUS STATUS_SHOCK_00), kept verbatim at Rolls 1 on AWR: with a single roll slot every success is a PERFECT (C-ATK-03), so the SHOCK rider clears its PERFECT-only gate (C-STATUS-10) on any hit. SHOCK then auto-fails one enemy roll slot unless they pin focus (C-STATUS-20). ATK/CRT sit at the HANDBOW|RARE curve p50s (14/15).

Loc.Name: Galvanic Handwraps
Loc.Description: Copper thread wound through silk. The wearer's fingertips smell faintly of rain and burnt air.

Items.DesignNote: Caster gloves for the shock kit: MAG is a flat additive to the attack stat for magical-school damage (C-ATK-04), directly boosting the set's lightning bolts, and CRT pays off because shock builds fish for PERFECT rolls anyway - crits roll only on PERFECT (C-CRIT-01). STATUS_IMMUNITY_SHOCK mirrors live lightning weapons' self-protection; SHOCK denial matters because it auto-fails a roll slot unless focused (C-STATUS-20). All stats within ARMOR_HANDS|RARE curve.

Loc.Name: Stormheart Conduit
Loc.Description: A splinter of fulgurite set in silver. It does not store the storm; it invites it.

Items.DesignNote: Set artifact, modeled on live TRINKET_TALISMAN_LIGHTNING_00 (ARTIFACT, DAM_LIGHTNING 25 + STATUS_IMMUNITY_SHOCK): DAM_* stats give +1% damage per point against enemies carrying that tag (C-ATK-07), so it rewards hunting LIGHTNING-tagged foes and pairs with the set's shock output. Both stats at the observed ARMOR_TRINKET|ARTIFACT maxes (DAM_LIGHTNING 25, SPD 3) - ARTIFACT is allowed to reach max.

Loc.Name: Oathfirst
Loc.Description: The vanguard's vow, ground to a point: be first through the gate, and let nothing touch you on the way.

Items.DesignNote: Set artifact skirmish blade: RAPIER ClassAbilityTemplate verbatim (SPD-rolled blade kit). SKILL_EAGER forces acting first (C-PROC-12), trumping the once-per-combat initiative roll of SPD + rand(0..10) (C-TGT-04); EVD is a binary total-negation dodge (C-STAT-20); PA adds a primary action (C-STAT-18). SKILL_PARRY is blade-gated (C-PROC-08) and appears on live rapiers. Stat line mirrors the live ARTIFACT rapier curve exactly (RAPIER|ARTIFACT: ATK 18, CRT 10, EVD 5, PA 1); SKILL_EAGER itself is precedented on live rapiers (RAPIER_TOYMAKER_BASIC_00).

Loc.Name: Vanguard's Striders
Loc.Description: Soles worn thin from always being a step ahead. Brambles, nets, and grasping hands find nothing to hold.

Items.DesignNote: Initiative/evasion boots: SPD feeds the once-per-combat initiative roll of SPD + rand(0..10) (C-TGT-04) and EVD is a binary dodge capped at 95 (C-STAT-20). STATUS_IMMUNITY_ENTANGLE protects both halves - ENTANGLE blocks melee/move/flee AND disables dodging entirely (C-STATUS-23), so immunity keeps the evasion plan online. Stats within ARMOR_FEET|RARE curve (SPD max 5, EVD max 6, MOV 1), modeled on live BOOTS_SPEED_LIGHT_00.

Loc.Name: Standard of the Oath
Loc.Description: A company standard on a fighting haft. Where it is planted, the line does not waver - it advances.

Items.DesignNote: Banner-polearm party anchor: POLEARM_2H ClassAbilityTemplate verbatim (four AWR/3 sweep-and-shove attacks). SKILL_ENCOURAGE flips one ally fail slot into a success, TAL-scaled at radius 2 (C-PROC-12) - a banner you keep near the line. PSPD is a P-prefixed party-wide stat applied to every player (C-STAT-04), nudging the whole party's initiative rolls (C-TGT-04). ATK 20/RES 3 sit near the POLEARM_2H|RARE curve p50s (19.5/3.5).

Loc.Name: Oathkeeper's Halfplate
Loc.Description: Light enough to lead the charge, proud enough to be seen doing it. The dents are all on the front.

Items.DesignNote: Skirmisher body armor: EVD 6 rides the binary-dodge check (EVD x 0.01, cap 95, total negation - C-STAT-20) while SKILL_STEADFAST is a verified item-passive-ready skill (block to 0 damage, VIT/DEF/RES-scaled - C-PROC-12) as the fallback when the dodge doesn't come up. PEVD extends dodge party-wide (C-STAT-04). All stats within ARMOR_BODY|RARE curve (EVD max 10, SPD max 5, PEVD max 4).

Loc.Name: Pennon of the Vanguard
Loc.Description: A ribbon from the first banner ever carried through a breach. Enemies watch it flutter when they should be watching the blade.

Items.DesignNote: Support trinket mirroring live TRINKET_DISTRACT_00 (SKL 5 + SKILL_DISTRACT): DISTRACT flips one enemy success slot into a failure, TAL-scaled (C-PROC-12), and the SKL stat adds +1% to EVERY skill proc roll (C-PROC-02), feeding the whole set's ENCOURAGE/DISTRACT/EAGER package. PDEF 2 is a party-wide defense aura (C-STAT-04), within ARMOR_TRINKET|RARE curve (PDEF max 3).
